title: Sycophantic Chatbots Cause Delusional Spiraling, Even in Ideal Bayesians
reasoning: The paper focuses on formalizing and modeling the dynamics of belief formation and delusional spiraling (specifically in relation to sycophancy in AI). This is fundamentally a study in formal epistemology—how agents update beliefs based on evidence—which is explicitly mentioned in the user's criteria. Additionally, it addresses the ethical and social harms (including deaths and lawsuits) resulting from these AI-induced beliefs.
